## Summary

Describe your change and the reason for it.

## Testing

- [ ] PHP syntax checks
- [ ] Relevant CLI tests
- [ ] Live DB/hosting checks described or clearly marked as unverified

## Security and compatibility

- [ ] No credentials, user data, logs, or runtime files committed
- [ ] Owner scoping, role checks, CSRF and protected paths preserved
- [ ] Schema and upgrade docs updated if needed
- [ ] Shared-hosting compatibility maintained
